arguments.text: Bug #4 (tree.go, case-insensitive lookup) fixed: in `findCaseInsensitivePathRec`, after the non-wildcard-children branch the code did `n = n.children[0]`, but the wildcard child is always kept at the END of the children array (`addChild`, and `getValue` uses `children[len-1]`). So for a node with several children plus a wildcard, the lookup picked a regular child and panicked with "invalid node type". It now selects `n.children[len(n.children)-1]`. Verified: `findCaseInsensitivePath` no longer panics and returns the case-corrected path for such trees; full `go test ./...` passes.
